title: Unified messaging inbox
summary: All your chats — WhatsApp, Messenger, SMS, Slack — in one app.
whyTempting: Context-switching between messaging apps is a universal annoyance.
whyItFails: Platforms block you. Messaging apps don't offer APIs and break unofficial integrations. Security concerns. Users hesitate to hand all messages to a third party. Constant breakage. Maintenance never ends.
whatWouldChange: Regulation forcing messaging interoperability (e.g. EU Digital Markets Act).

attempts.outcome: Acquired by Google, then shut down
attempts.notes: Browser-based messenger across Yahoo!, MSN, AIM and Google Talk; products discontinued after the 2012 acquisition.

reasons.detail: Platforms block you: Messaging apps don't offer APIs and break unofficial integrations.
Security concerns: Users hesitate to hand all messages to a third party.
